mapper.select:
-- 관리자 회원관리 목록을 조회한다. SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.login_id, u.name, u.phone, u.email, u.status_code, u.password_reset_required, u.last_login_at, u.created_at, u.updated_at, COALESCE( string_agg(ur.role_code, ',' ORDER BY r.sort_order ASC, ur.role_code ASC), '' ) AS role_codes_text FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_roles ur ON ur.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN roles r ON r.role_code = ur.role_code
GROUP BY u.id, u.login_id, u.name, u.phone, u.email, u.status_code, u.password_reset_required, u.last_login_at, u.created_at, u.updated_at ORDER BY u.created_at DESC, u.login_id ASC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
-- 관리자 회원관리 목록 총 건수를 조회한다. SELECT count(1) FROM users u

-- 관리자 회원관리 단건 상세를 조회한다. SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.login_id, u.name, u.phone, u.email, u.status_code, u.password_reset_required, u.last_login_at, u.created_at, u.updated_at, COALESCE( string_agg(ur.role_code, ',' ORDER BY r.sort_order ASC, ur.role_code ASC), '' ) AS role_codes_text FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_roles ur ON ur.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN roles r ON r.role_code = ur.role_code WHERE u.id = #{userId} GROUP BY u.id, u.login_id, u.name, u.phone, u.email, u.status_code, u.password_reset_required, u.last_login_at, u.created_at, u.updated_at
-- 권한 선택 목록을 조회한다. SELECT r.role_code, r.role_name, r.sort_order FROM roles r ORDER BY r.sort_order ASC, r.role_code ASC
mapper.update: -- 관리자 회원관리에서 계정 상태를 변경한다. UPDATE users SET status_code = #{statusCode}, updated_by = #{actorUserId}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: -- 관리자 회원관리에서 권한을 부여한다. INSERT INTO user_roles ( user_id, role_code, created_by ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{roleCode}, #{actorUserId} ) ON CONFLICT (user_id, role_code) DO NOTHING

-- 관리자 회원관리 변경 이력을 감사 로그에 기록한다. INSERT INTO audit_logs ( actor_user_id, action_code, resource_type, resource_id, result_code, metadata_json ) VALUES ( #{actorUserId}, #{actionCode}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{resultCode}, CAST(#{metadataJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb) )
